suggested_requirements.text: The system shall allow a guest to register an account.
The system shall allow a user to log in.
The system shall allow a user to validate a new account via email.
The system shall allow a user to retrieve a forgotten password.
The system shall allow a VUB-network user to search for publications by keyword, author, or date range.
The system shall allow a user to perform an advanced search for publications.
The system shall allow a user to order search results by title, author, or year.
The system shall allow a user to export search results to HTML, PDF, or PS format.
The system shall allow a user to search for publications by similarity.
The system shall allow a member to change their account details.
The system shall allow a member to log off.
The system shall allow a publisher to upload a publication in BibTeX or RIS format.
The system shall automatically retrieve bibliographical information from uploaded publication text.
The system shall allow a publisher to edit their own publications.
The system shall allow a publisher to perform a bulk upload of publications.
The system shall allow a moderator to manage user levels for their department.
The system shall allow a moderator to manage group permissions.
The system shall allow a moderator to edit author information.
The system shall allow a moderator to edit departmental publications.
The system shall allow an administrator to access a control panel.
The system shall allow an administrator to create or delete users.
The system shall allow an administrator to create or delete groups.
The system shall allow an administrator to edit all publications.
The system shall encrypt user passwords during submission and storage.
The system shall enforce access control based on user roles.
The web interface shall comply with the W3C XHTML 1.0 Transitional standard.
The system shall log errors to notify the administrator of technical difficulties.
The system shall run on a Linux-based environment.
The system shall use a MySQL database.
The system shall be documented using RDoc.
The system shall use Git for configuration management.
